dct_creator_sm: von Konigslow, Taika (Department of Population Medicine. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4005-4359
dct_description_sm:
Supplemental tables and figures for Navel healing in male and female Holstein calves over the first 14 days of life: A longitudinal cohort study. The supplemental materials include:

  • A modified calf vitality score sheet;
  • Reference material describing and illustrating navel healing and measurements outcomes.; and,
  • Descriptive statistics of navel measurements by day evaluated over a 14 day observation period following birth in 68 male and female calves at the University of Guelph Livestock Research and Innovation Center, Dairy Facility in Elora, Ontario, Canada.
dct_title_s: Supplemental materials for Navel healing in male and female Holstein calves over the first 14 days of life: A longitudinal cohort study
